senses.gloss: f.(b. h. גבח)high forehead; baldness in front.
units: Ḥull. 65ᵇ הַבָּא ואין לו ג׳ a species of locusts which occasionally appear, having no long-stretched heads (= ראשו ארוך ib.); [Ar.: a protuberance on the back, hump].
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 10:10">Neg. X, 10</cite> <he>הג׳</he> a leprous affection on the front of the head (making it bald).
Ib. איזו היא ג׳ מן הקדקד וכ׳ which portion of the head is called gabbaḥath? From the crown sliding down forward to where the hair begins on the forehead; Sifra Thazr. Par. 5. ch. X.
<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 4:11">Tosef. Neg. IV, 11</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: the front or outside of cloth; the nap of new cloth, opp. קרחת. Sifra l. c. ch. XV בְּגַבַּחְתּוֹ אלו חדשים b’gabbaḥto (Lev. XIII, 55) means new cloths (v. Targ. O. a. l.).
